issues.ti: Wrapper M_AXIS duty drops to ~50% with Meyr loop active
issues.de: After ISS-22 fix (frac_m_tready=1), the wrapper's m_axis emits 576 real beats over ~1150 cycles = ~50% duty (rotator pipeline natural rate). Previously the smoke gate measured ~95% duty -- but that was X-prop garbage from the floating tready being counted as 'valid' beats. The new measurement is honest. For the project spec '250 Msps continuous, zero drops', the wrapper FSM needs concurrent Meyr processing (slot k FFT/IFFT running while slot k+1 enters frac_corrector). Currently the wrapper is strictly one-shot (S_IDLE → S_RUN waits for Meyr → S_DONE → S_IDLE). This serializes throughput to ~1 frame per Meyr-latency.
